description: Echo return loss enhancement over explicit far-end-only intervals
description_zh: 明确远端单讲区间的回声返回损耗增强
implementation: Float64 pooled energy ratio; no gain normalization or epsilon
caveats: Not defined as an echo-only measure during double-talk.
Microphone-based ERLE includes noise; label this signal definition explicitly.
Batches pool energies, not per-recording dB. Zero residual returns infinite_result and null.

validation.scope: analytic fixtures, exhaustive threshold comparison or real-waveform energy checks, and invalid controls

description_zh: 并列分数组合后的插值等错误率
implementation: scikit-learn complete ROC + explicit detection operating-point convention
caveats: Whole trial list, both classes required; never average per-utterance EER/minDCF.
Labels 1=target and 0=nontarget. Score direction is explicit. Ties share one operating point.
EER uses linear ROC interpolation, which can differ from closest empirical-point conventions.

validation.scope: analytic fixtures, exhaustive threshold comparison or real-waveform energy checks, and invalid controls

caveats: Whole trial list, both classes required; never average per-utterance EER/minDCF.
Labels 1=target and 0=nontarget. Score direction is explicit. Ties share one operating point.
Default costs 1/1; normalized=True. p_target is mandatory; minDCF is an oracle sweep, not deployment-threshold actual DCF.
